selection.limitation: Nine visually bounded threats and three true on-foot controls retained. Twenty-one additional independent verified threats and twenty-seven genuine playable controls are missing. Thirty initially proposed controls were rejected as cutscenes without a HUD; stale health values had survived their absent maps. Strict flat-map search of all integer-second centers in these seven sources yielded only three disjoint windows without aim/fire. Vehicle controls are excluded because R2 is throttle, not fire; a context-aware vehicle answer set needs a separate reviewed dataset.
